capabilities: Create one note per title with covers, ratings and trailers
Auto-fill metadata from open sources and Wikipedia
Sync lists and progress with connected services
Show the library as a cover gallery, shelf or canvas
disambiguation: Not a plugin or file-library manager; it catalogs personal media and collectibles as notes.
extras: Extensive privacy section lists every contacted host; Nintendo sign-in routes through a third-party signing service (nxapi-znca-api) with a prompt; many connectors are desktop-only; more documentation lives in an external wiki.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog and track films, books, games and other media with their covers, ratings and progress.
